kebab_example: aliyun btripopen cost-center-query --user-id user1 --thirdpart-id cost1 --need-org-entity false --title '测试成本中心' --disable 0 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CostCenterQuery

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display member information. This parameter is returned when the cost center applies to partial members
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要展示成员信息，当成本中心为部分人员适用的时候有返回
parameters.name: need_org_entity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the cost center is disabled. Valid values:

- **0**: Not disabled.
- **1**: Disabled.

If this parameter is not specified, all data is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
是否禁用，取值：
- **0**：不禁用
- **1**：禁用

若不传值，默认查询全部数据
parameters.name: disable

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
